vocab.example_vi: Một câu hỏi đơn giản về sự kiện giúp tôi phá tan sự ngại ngùng.

vocab.example: There are almost two thousand attendees at the expo today.
vocab.example_vi: Hôm nay có gần hai nghìn người tham dự hội chợ.

vocab.meaning_vi: phiên thảo luận có nhiều diễn giả

vocab.example: I will hand out our new product leaflets near the entrance.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ phát tờ rơi sản phẩm mới của chúng ta gần lối vào.

vocab.example: We make an impression because we ask questions instead of selling.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi tạo được ấn tượng vì chúng tôi đặt câu hỏi thay vì chỉ bán hàng.

vocab.example: Please write your email on the sign-up sheet before you leave.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng ghi email của bạn vào phiếu đăng ký trước khi ra về.

listening.title: Meeting new contacts at the tech expo

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Hoa, there are almost two thousand attendees today. Where should we start?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Let us stay near the coffee area first. It is the easiest place to break the ice.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Good idea. I will hand out our new product leaflets while people are waiting.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Remember to ask questions instead of selling. That is how we make an impression here.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Agreed. There is also a panel discussion about cloud security at eleven.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: We should join it. Many of our target customers will sit in that room.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: I will bring the sign-up sheet so people can leave their email addresses.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Perfect. If someone looks interested, we swap contacts and book a call later.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: How many good conversations do you want from today?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Twenty is realistic. Quality matters more than the number of business cards.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Manager)
lines.text: True. Next week I will write to everyone and try to keep in touch.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Exactly. The event ends today, but the relationship starts tomorrow.

questions.q: Where do Nam and Hoa decide to start?
What is the panel discussion about?
How many good conversations does Hoa want today?

shadowing: Let us start near the coffee area because it is easy to break the ice.
I will hand out our leaflets and invite people to visit our stand.
Ask good questions if you really want to make an impression today.
Please write your name and email on the sign-up sheet before you leave.
I will send a short message next week so we can keep in touch.
